purpose: Direction gate for deciding which-side TL is eligible to draw on each source timeframe.

terms.HL: The decision pivot between the two same-side TL anchors. FALLING: LOW between HIGH1/HIGH2. RISING: HIGH between LOW1/LOW2.
terms.TL: Trendline candidate drawn in the direction allowed by the HL decision gate.
terms.retracement_38: Minimum retracement used to recognize/confirm a reaction Turn/Pivot. It is NOT the HL price.

candidate_structure.FALLING: HIGH1 -> LOW(HL) -> HIGH2, with HIGH2 < HIGH1
candidate_structure.RISING: LOW1 -> HIGH(HL) -> LOW2, with LOW2 > LOW1

activation.FALLING: after HIGH2 forms, a closed-bar close below the LOW(HL) makes the falling TL eligible
activation.RISING: after LOW2 forms, a closed-bar close above the HIGH(HL) makes the rising TL eligible

rule.hl_display: Always draw the decision HL tied to the selected TL, even after it has been broken.
rule.color: HL uses the same color as its source-timeframe TL.
rule.scope: Evaluate on the source timeframe; Plan-B destinations copy the selected TL geometry without re-selection.

important: The selected TL anchors and HL must belong to the same N-structure.
FALLING TL is HIGH-to-HIGH; its decision HL is the LOW between those anchors.
RISING TL is LOW-to-LOW; its decision HL is the HIGH between those anchors.
A new-direction TL is not eligible until its decision HL has been broken.
38% confirms reaction pivots; 38% itself is not the HL price.
Current break implementation uses closed-bar close provisionally; wick-vs-close remains for video validation.
HL remains visible after the break and uses the same source-TF color as the TL.

research_candidate.display_scope: source timeframe chart only during validation
